alt: A sculpted diorama depicts the Three Little Pigs story, featuring a pig in a yellow hat reading inside a brick house while a wolf in a red hat stands at the door next to a pile of sticks.
An elaborate cake sculpture depicts a rustic brick house with a textured shingled roof, set on a green grassy base featuring a dirt path, gnarled trees, rocks, and small white flowers.

A sculpted diorama of the Three Little Pigs story features a pig in blue overalls building a brick house, two other pigs standing nearby, and the Big Bad Wolf in a top hat peeking from behind the structure, all set on a green base with flowers and acorns.
